target.projection_interpretation: planar XZ; projection-space normal is local Y

matrix_test.serialized_direction: object to projection coordinates: q = R * p
matrix_test.interpretation: Applying the serialized siXYZ rotation directly to object-space geometry maps the textured face normal almost entirely onto projection-space +Y, exactly the discarded axis for planar-XZ mapping. Transposing/inverting the rotation produces the wrong projection axis.

correction_history.reason: The first interpretation compared object-space support-axis vectors rather than applying the candidate coordinate transforms to the actual face normal. For q=R*p, the object-space normal of a qY-constant plane is row Y of R; equivalently R*n should become +/-Y. Re-evaluating the face39 oracle establishes direct R, not R-transpose.

evidence_boundary: The asymmetric geometry strongly distinguishes direct R from transpose/inverse R for relation code 400.
Softimage SDK documentation independently establishes default Euler order siXYZ, completing the Rz*Ry*Rx construction.
Relation code 401 remains a distinct material-level binding path and is not generalized from this result without its own validation.
